title: JClaw eval suite
description: A versioned set of eval cases. One suite per file, named <id>.v<version>.json. JCLAW-875.

id.description: Suite identifier. Must match the filename prefix.

version.description: Suite version. Must match the .v<N> segment of the filename. Bump by adding a new file beside the old one — never by editing a published suite in place, or the pass rates stop comparing.

id.description: Case identifier, unique within the suite. Reports and regression comparisons key on it, so renaming a case discards its history.

input.description: The user turn sent to the agent.

rubric.description: One line stating what this case is testing and why it earns its place in the suite.

kind.description: Every kind is decidable without a model call. Model-judged checks land with the critic (JCLAW-836).

args.description: contains_all / not_contains_any: the substrings (case-insensitive). matches: one regex. tool_called / tool_not_called: one tool name (exact).

schema.description: json_schema only: the schema the response must satisfy. EvalScorer implements a documented subset — type, properties, required, items, enum, additionalProperties, description — and the loader rejects any other keyword rather than ignoring it.

limit.description: max_llm_calls only: the call budget for the case (JCLAW-833's efficiency NFR, measured via llm_call_count from JCLAW-882).
